description: Declare or retract genre tags for an artist in your local sidecar (~/.spotify-mcp/genre-tags.json), which library_genre_report and filter_by_genre consume. add requires at least one tag; remove drops the listed tags, or the artist entirely when none are listed. Supports dry_run preview.

action.description: add tags to an artist, or remove tags/artist

artist.description: Artist name exactly as it appears in your library

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

tags.description: Tags to add/remove; omit on remove to drop the artist entirely

name: tag_management
